# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

# Figure 6 and Figure S11/S12

Data analysis scripts for re-creating Figure 6 and Figure S11/S12.

# Read data

```{r}
## JAVELIN 101
JAVELIN_SE <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/validation_JAVELIN_SE.rds") 

## Other
gene_signatures <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/validation_genesignatures.rds") 
POORUP <- gene_signatures$survival_ecotype_poor
FAVUP <- gene_signatures$survival_ecotype_favorable
col_group <- setNames(c("#0571B0", "gold3", "#CA0020"),c("Favorable","Medium","Poor"))
```

# Figure 6 

## 6A

```{r}
# Perform nearest template prediction for survival ecotypes in full TCGA KIRC cohort
## Step 1: Prepare expression matrix (genes x samples, log2 scale)
tpm_mat <- assays(JAVELIN_SE)$tpm
log2_tpm <- log2(tpm_mat + 1)
expr_mat_JAV <- ematAdjust(log2_tpm, method = "RLE")
rownames(expr_mat_JAV) <- rowData(JAVELIN_SE)$gene

# Step 2: Create subtype templates (Gene signatures)
names(FAVUP) <- rep("FAV", length(FAVUP))
names(POORUP) <- rep("POOR", length(POORUP))
keyup <- c(FAVUP, POORUP)
template_mat <- data.frame(class = factor(names(keyup)), 
           probe = unname(keyup))

# Step 3: Run NTP classification with permutations
set.seed(22)
ntp_result <- ntp(
  emat = expr_mat_JAV,           
  template = template_mat,
  distance = "cosine",
  nPerm = 1000,              
  seed = 22,                 
  doPlot = FALSE
)

# Step 4: Convert predictions into groups
ntp_out <- ntp_result %>% rownames_to_column("PID") %>% mutate(group_predict = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, as.character(prediction), "NOT"))
JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene <- ntp_out$group_predict[match(JAVELIN_SE$UUID, ntp_out$PID)]
JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "POOR"] <- "Poor"
JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "NOT"] <- "Medium"
JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene == "FAV"] <- "Favorable"

# Step 5: Show survival trends
# Combined
surv_out <- colData(JAVELIN_SE) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(UUID, OS, OS_CNSR, PFS, PFS_CNSR, survival_ecotype_gene) %>% unique()

fit <- survfit(Surv(OS, OS_CNSR) ~ survival_ecotype_gene, data = surv_out)
ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, 
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          palette = c("#0571B0", "gold3","#CA0020"),
          conf.int = FALSE
)

fit <- survfit(Surv(PFS, PFS_CNSR) ~ survival_ecotype_gene, data = surv_out)
ggsurvplot(fit,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, 
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          palette = c("#0571B0", "gold3","#CA0020"),
          conf.int = FALSE
)
```

## 6B

```{r}
# MULTIVARIABLE COX MODEL 
## Treatment benefit for survival ecotypes

# 1. OS 
Cox_df <- as.data.frame(colData(JAVELIN_SE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(UUID, survival_ecotype_gene, Treatment, Tumor_Location) %>% 
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("TKI", "IO+VEGF")),
    OS_months = JAVELIN_SE$OS[match(UUID, JAVELIN_SE$UUID)],
    status_OS = JAVELIN_SE$OS_CNSR[match(UUID, JAVELIN_SE$UUID)]
  )
tme_groups <- unique(Cox_df$survival_ecotype_gene)
cox_results <- lapply(tme_groups, function(group) {
  df_group <- Cox_df %>% filter(survival_ecotype_gene == group & !is.na(Treatment))
  model <- coxph(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ Treatment, data = df_group)
  summary(model)
  })
names(cox_results) <- tme_groups
plot_df_prop <- rbind(data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[1]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[1]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[1]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[1]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3), 
                      type = names(cox_results[1])),
      data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[2]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[2]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[2]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[2]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3),
                      type = names(cox_results[2])),
      data.frame(group = rownames(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],3),
                      HR = signif(cox_results[[3]]$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],3),
                      CI_low = signif(cox_results[[3]]$conf.int[,"lower .95"],3),
                      CI_high = signif(cox_results[[3]]$conf.int[,"upper .95"],3),
                      wald_test = signif(cox_results[[3]]$waldtest["pvalue"],3),
                      type = names(cox_results[3]))
)

ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(type,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Covariates")+
ylab("HR (OS) for PID groups")+
theme_classic()+
scale_y_log10()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

# 2. PFS
Cox_df <- as.data.frame(colData(JAVELIN_SE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(UUID, survival_ecotype_gene, Treatment, Tumor_Location) %>% 
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("TKI", "IO+VEGF")),

```

## 6C

```{r}
#ORR
se_sub <- JAVELIN_SE[, JAVELIN_SE$ORR %in% c("PR", "PD", "CR")]
se_sub$ORR_comb <- ifelse(se_sub$ORR == "PD", "PD", "PR/CR")

df <- as.data.frame(colData(se_sub)[!is.na(se_sub$survival_ecotype_gene), c("Treatment", "ORR_comb", "survival_ecotype_gene")])
fisher_out <- c(paste0("Medium p = ",fisher.test(table(df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Medium",]$Treatment, df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Medium",]$ORR_comb))$p, "Poor p = ",fisher.test(table(df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Poor",]$Treatment, df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Poor",]$ORR_comb))$p, "Favorable p = ",fisher.test(table(df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Favorable",]$Treatment, df[df$survival_ecotype_gene == "Favorable",]$ORR_comb))$p))

dittoBarPlot(se_sub, var = "ORR_comb", group.by = "Treatment", split.by = "survival_ecotype_gene")+
  ggtitle(fisher_out)+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
```

# Figure S11

## S11A

```{r}
# Heatmap from predictions
probes_val <- template_mat$probe[template_mat$probe %in% rownames(expr_mat_JAV)]
gen_mat <- expr_mat_JAV[probes_val,]

# Annotations
row_anno <- data.frame(gene = rownames(gen_mat))
row_anno$cat <- template_mat$class[match(row_anno$gene, template_mat$probe)]
gene_col <- setNames(brewer.pal(3,"Set1")[1:2], rev(unfactor(unique(row_anno$cat))))
ra <- columnAnnotation(cat = row_anno$cat, col = list(cat = gene_col))
col_anno <- data.frame(PID = colnames(gen_mat))
col_anno$group <- JAVELIN_SE$survival_ecotype_gene[match(col_anno$PID, ntp_out$PID)]
col_anno_ob <- rowAnnotation(group = col_anno$group, 
                                col = list(group = col_group)) 

# Plot
Heatmap(t(gen_mat), 
        column_split = row_anno$cat,
        row_split = col_anno$group,
        right_annotation = col_anno_ob, 
        show_row_names = FALSE, 
        show_row_dend = TRUE, 
        show_column_dend = TRUE
        )%v%
  ra
```
